---
name: steward
description: Triggers when the user asks for an agent health check, cleanup of rules or memory, or agent rot inspection, or when the health report is stale. Inspects the agent environment only.

# Agent Environment Steward

Inventory prompts, rules, skills, memory, hooks, MCP, subagents, commands, plugins, and environment. Report findings with evidence, apply only confirmed changes, and move removed assets to trash.
